北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴冷，体感偏低，记得多穿衣服，注意保暖！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but cold, feels colder. Keep warm and layer up!
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波多云，体感偏凉，早晚出门记得添衣保暖哦。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is cloudy and cool, feels chilly. Remember to add clothes in morning/evening.
宁波.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴冷，体感偏凉，早晚注意添衣保暖，别着凉。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and cool. Add clothes to keep warm, don't catch cold.
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州风力 4级，多云温差大，外出注意防风保暖。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou, it's windy at 4 levels and cloudy. Mind the wind and keep warm.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳风力 4级，体感舒适，但仍需注意早晚温差。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is comfortable with 4-level wind. Still mind the day-night temperature difference.
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 4级

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴好微凉，体感较冷，湿度大，记得保暖防潮。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and cool, feels chilly with high humidity. Keep warm and dry!
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴冷，湿度高达 90%，湿冷感明显，注意保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and cold with 90% humidity. It feels damp and chilly, keep warm.
南京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温适中，早晚出门仍需注意添衣。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with moderate temperature. Remember to add clothes in morning/evening.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉湿度 100% 体感湿冷，请务必注意保暖防潮！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan, 100% humidity makes it damp and cold. Keep warm and dry!
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴冷，体感偏低，记得多穿衣服，防止着凉哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast and cold, feels chilly. Wear more clothes to prevent catching cold.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，湿度 92% 易感湿冷，注意保暖防潮。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy with 92% humidity, feels damp and chilly. Keep warm and dry!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒又风大，务必多穿戴，谨防冻伤！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold and windy. Bundle up and prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -18℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳严寒，风力 5级，风寒效应明显，请务必保暖！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is severe cold with 5-level wind. Wind chill is strong, please keep very warm!
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明有雾，能见度低，驾车出行请减速慢行。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is foggy, low visibility. Drive slowly and carefully.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，风力 5级较大，出门注意防风保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast with strong 5-level wind. Mind the wind and keep warm.
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 5级

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，风力 5级，风寒效应明显，注意防风保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy with 5-level wind, strong wind chill. Mind the wind and keep warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，风力 4级，风寒感强，注意防风和保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy with 4-level wind, strong wind chill. Mind the wind and keep warm.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦有霾，湿度高，外出建议戴口罩，注意健康。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu has haze and high humidity. Wear a mask outdoors and mind your health.
漳浦.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴好，早晚微凉，出门注意适时添衣哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny but cool. Add clothes as needed, especially morning/evening.
慈溪.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃
